s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 10 claws and remove the front door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door opening weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 8 claws and remove the rear door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear door opening trim weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Center Pillar Garnish Lower RH

s2.ptxt: Spread the upper part of the garnish left and right and disengage the 2 claws A.
Pull toward the vehicle inside, disengage the 2 claws B and 2 clips, and remove the center pillar garnish LWR RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Side Airbag Sensor Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Make sure that the ignition switch is OFF.
Make sure that the negative battery terminal is disconnected.

item.ptxt: If work is performed without disconnecting the battery negative terminal, the airbag may deploy even if an impact is applied only to the side airbag sensor assembly RH by itself, so always confirm that the battery negative terminal is disconnected before performing work.
After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and pin portion, and remove the side airbag sensor assembly RH from the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: As the pin portion (anti-rotation portion) of the side airbag sensor assembly RH is easily damaged, loosen the bolt while holding the side airbag sensor assembly RH by hand.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from the side airbag sensor assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Side Airbag Sensor Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Vehicles not involved in a collision, or vehicles involved in a collision in which the airbag did not deploy

s3.ptxt: If the side pillar or surrounding area has been damaged and the airbag has not deployed, replace the side airbag sensor assembly with a new one if any of the following applies.

specitem.ptxt: Deformation or peeling paint on the bracket or sensor body
Scratches, cracks or damage on the side airbag sensor assembly and connector
Damaged serial number or peeling label
